Document type: adjuster_file. Page 1 of 2.

<page>
Harbor Point Mutual Auto Insurance
Bodily Injury Unit
Claim Notes
Claim number:
C-1145
Claimant:
James Whitaker
Adjuster:
Jerry Hanson
9 Jun 2025
First notice of loss received from the insured's policyholder reporting a low-speed head-on collision at an intersection,
with the claimant seated in the passenger vehicle. Coverage was verified and the driver is named on the policy.
13 Jul 2025
Police report obtained; responding officer confirms the claimant was present in the vehicle at the scene and
documents the impact location consistent with the insured's description.
18 Aug 2025
Recorded statement taken from the other driver, who independently describes the same sequence of events and the
vehicle positions at impact.
28 Aug 2025
Photographs of both vehicles reviewed. Damage to the front bumper, hood and airbag deployment pattern appears
consistent with the reported impact speed and direction.
29 Sep 2025
Two independent witnesses interviewed by phone; both confirm the accident occurred as described and that the
claimant was in the passenger seat.
7 Oct 2025
Repair estimate and vehicle history checked. No prior damage to the vehicle is on record, and nothing suggests the
damage predates the policy inception.
22 Oct 2025
Claimant's representing attorney submitted a demand package listing a concussion diagnosis following the collision.
The reported injury is consistent with the mechanism and force of the crash.
6 Nov 2025
Medical records reviewed. Treatment followed a typical course, with frequent visits early on that tapered as
symptoms improved. Records also note a minor strain to the same area many years ago that resolved fully.
24 Dec 2025
Claimant's account has remained the same across every conversation, including the initial call, the written statement
and the attorney-led interview.
1 Jan 2026
Medical review notes the prior strain healed completely and does not appear to account for the current symptoms or
treatment pattern.
13 Jan 2026
File reviewed and assessed as consistent across accident facts, damage, witness accounts and medical course.
Proceeding with evaluation of the bodily injury claim under counsel's representation.
</page>

Rate each feature below that THIS page gives evidence about. Leave out a feature the page
says nothing about. The ratings are listed from least to most suspicious.
- injury_crash_fit: Does the claimed injury fit the type and force of the crash? Allowed: Strong, Reasonable, Unclear, Inconsistent.
- treatment_growth: Did the treatment grow beyond what this injury needs? Allowed: Normal, Elevated, Disproportionate, Extreme.
- pre_existing_condition: Did an earlier condition of the same body area add to the complaints? Allowed: None, Minor, Material, Predominant.
- occurrence_support: Do independent sources (witnesses, photos, cameras, the other driver) confirm that the accident happened as described? Allowed: Confirmed, Partially corroborated, Uncorroborated, Contradicted, Suspected staged.
- damage_crash_fit: Does the vehicle damage fit the described impact? Allowed: Strong, Reasonable, Unclear, Inconsistent.
- account_stability: Did the claimant's account of the accident stay the same over time? Allowed: Stable, Clarified, Materially changed.
- occupant_presence: Was the claimant really in the vehicle at the time of the crash? Allowed: Verified, Unclear, Added later, Not present.
- prior_damage_evidence: Is there evidence of vehicle damage from before this crash? Allowed: None, Possible, Documented, Material.
- known_loss_evidence: Is there evidence the damage existed or was known before the coverage started? Allowed: Weak, Moderate, Strong.
- driver_status: Is the driver of the insured vehicle on the policy? Allowed: Listed, Household, Unlisted, Excluded.

For each rated feature give:
- "rating": exactly one of the allowed ratings,
- "confidence": "High", "Medium" or "Low" (how clearly the page shows it),
- "quote": one or two sentences copied EXACTLY from the page that support the rating, with any
  spelling errors as they are,
- "reason": one short sentence.
JSON format:
